item.title: [Recap] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić finished Tuesday’s loss to the Mavericks with 18 points (6-of-14 FGs, 5-of-5 FTs), 11 rebounds, five assists, one steal and one three-pointer.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić finished Tuesday’s loss to the Mavericks with 18 points (6-of-14 FGs, 5-of-5 FTs), 11 rebounds, five assists, one steal and one three-pointer.

Jokić recorded his 13th double-double of the season, but this was far from a vintage performance for the three-time MVP. He committed five turnovers, the most in a game for The Joker since recording seven in a November 16 loss to the Suns. Jokić remains among the most valuable players in fantasy basketball regardless of format, but he’s come back to the pack somewhat after multiple seasons of dominance.

Raphielle Johnson

item.title: [Injury] Victor Wembanyama (SAS): Victor Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday’s game against the Trail Blazers.
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday’s game against the Trail Blazers.

Wembanyama did not play in Monday’s win over the Kings, and while he was expected to be available on Wednesday, the Spurs are officially listing him as questionable. If Wemby remains out, Luke Kornet would get another start after recording his first double-double of the season on Monday.

Raphielle Johnson

Fonte: NBA Injury Report

item.title: [Injury] Victor Wembanyama (SAS): Victor Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Kings.
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Kings.

Wembanyama, who torched the Pelicans on Saturday, is dealing with lower back tightness. If he can’t play against the Kings, Luke Kornet is the most likely replacement in the starting lineup.

Raphielle Johnson

Fonte: NBA Injury Report
